# Adirondack Seafood Co.

> > Fresh seafood restaurant and fish market in Hudson Falls, NY, serving New England-style seafood, fish fry, and daily specials since establishment by commercial fisherman Mike Willig.

Adirondack Seafood Co. is located at 115 River Street in Hudson Falls, New York, offering dine-in, takeout, and fresh seafood market services. The restaurant specializes in New England-style seafood dishes, lunch baskets, fish and chips, and features daily lunch and dinner specials with fresh catches from Iceland, Alaska, Maine, and Canada.

## Key Topics

- Fresh seafood
- New England-style seafood
